patthana13.8:1.1: dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo ca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana13.8:2.1: bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana13.8:3.1: neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.8:4.1: dassanena pahātabbañca neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.8:5.1: bhāvanāya pahātabbañca neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.8:7.1: sahajātavārampi sampayuttavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ. dassanena pahātabbahetukattike nadassanena pahātabbahetukattikaṃ
